name: Wolfpine Village Batch 03 - Ground Blend and Foreground Depth
purpose: Third production batch for finishing assets that blend roads, soften hard edges, and add controlled foreground depth without hiding required hotspots.
global_prompt_lock: Original classic pre-rendered pseudo-isometric CRPG asset, fixed 3/4 isometric camera, painted/pre-rendered look, not pixel-art, grounded low-fantasy frontier village, muted natural earth colors, warm late-afternoon or soft overcast daylight, readable contact shadow, dark timber, old stone, weathered plaster, moss, mud, cobble, no UI, no text.
global_negative_prompt: pixel art, front-facing flat perspective, inconsistent camera angle, unreadable silhouette, no contact shadow, modern materials, glossy heroic fantasy, horror-dark lighting, readable text, labels, signs with words, UI, impossible architecture, stairs to windows, blocked doors, full scene background, characters, monsters
batch_acceptance_checks: All three finishing assets have candidate PNGs or documented candidate references.
Ground/vegetation assets can repeat without obvious hard seams.
Decals blend into mud/cobble/road surfaces without sticker-like edges.
Foreground occluder does not hide required doors, exits, or hotspots.
Every accepted candidate has source/license/generation notes before production use.

assets.generation_prompt_addon: Small village-edge grass and weed clump for damp low-fantasy settlement paths, muted natural greens, muddy root base, soft irregular silhouette, transparent-ready isolated asset, low contrast, repeatable without obvious pattern, for blending path edges and wall bases rather than blocking movement.
review_checks: Blends with mud and cobble edges.
Not too contrasty at game scale.
Does not imply collision unless densely clustered.

assets.generation_prompt_addon: Transparent-ready muddy wheel rut ground decal for wagon-worn village road, damp brown mud, subtle puddle sheen, irregular soft edges, pseudo-isometric ground-plane alignment, decal-like top-down painted texture that supports path direction without obscuring walkability, no hard rectangular boundary.
review_checks: Works over cobble, dirt, and road bases.
Does not look like a hard-edged sticker.

assets.generation_prompt_addon: Foreground pine branch occluder for classic CRPG village scene edge framing, dark green pine needles, rough branch bark, slightly softer focus than gameplay objects, transparent-ready isolated foreground element, asymmetrical edge silhouette, subtle warm daylight rim, meant for screen corners and upper foreground only.
review_checks: Looks like a foreground element, not a ground prop.
Soft enough to avoid distracting from gameplay.
Does not cover important interaction points.
Can frame scene edges and add depth without hiding doors or exits.
